verses.original: γάρ ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν ἐστιν Ὁμοία ἀνθρώπῳ οἰκοδεσπότῃ ὅστις ἐξῆλθεν ἅμα πρωῒ μισθώσασθαι ἐργάτας εἰς αὐτοῦ τὸν ἀμπελῶνα
verses.transliteration: gar hē basileia tōn ouranōn estin Homoia anthrōpō oikodespotē hostis exēlthen hama prōi misthōsasthai ergatas eis autou ton ampelōna
verses.literal: For the kingdom of heaven is like vvv a landowner who went out early in [the] morning to hire workers for his - vineyard

verses.original: δὲ συμφωνήσας μετὰ τῶν ἐργατῶν δηναρίου ἐκ τὴν ἡμέραν ἀπέστειλεν αὐτοὺς εἰς αὐτοῦ τὸν ἀμπελῶνα
verses.transliteration: de symphōnēsas meta tōn ergatōn dēnariou ek tēn hēmeran apesteilen autous eis autou ton ampelōna
verses.literal: - He agreed [to pay] - [them] a denarius for the day [and] sent them into his - vineyard

verses.original: Καὶ περὶ τρίτην ὥραν ἐξελθὼν εἶδεν ἄλλους ἑστῶτας ἐν τῇ ἀγορᾷ ἀργούς
verses.transliteration: Kai peri tritēn hōran exelthōn eiden allous hestōtas en tē agora argous
verses.literal: - About the third hour he went out [and] saw others standing in the marketplace doing nothing

verses.original: ὑμεῖς καὶ Ὑπάγετε εἰς τὸν ἀμπελῶνα καὶ εἶπεν ἐκείνοις καὶ δώσω ὑμῖν ὃ ἐὰν ᾖ δίκαιον
verses.transliteration: hymeis kai Hypagete eis ton ampelōna kai eipen ekeinois kai dōsō hymin ho ean ē dikaion
verses.literal: You also go into [my] vineyard - he said - and I will pay you whatever . . . is right

verses.original: δὲ οἱ ἀπῆλθον δὲ ἐξελθὼν Πάλιν περὶ ἕκτην καὶ ἐνάτην ὥραν ἐποίησεν ὡσαύτως
verses.transliteration: de hoi apēlthon de exelthōn Palin peri hektēn kai enatēn hōran epoiēsen hōsautōs
verses.literal: So - they went - He went out again about [the] sixth [hour] and [the] ninth hour [and] did the same thing

verses.original: δὲ Περὶ τὴν ἑνδεκάτην ἐξελθὼν εὗρεν ἄλλους ἑστῶτας Τί ἑστήκατε ὧδε ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν ἀργοί καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: de Peri tēn hendekatēn exelthōn heuren allous hestōtas Ti hestēkate hōde holēn tēn hēmeran argoi kai legei autois
verses.literal: - About the eleventh [hour] he went out [and] found still others standing [around] Why have you been standing here all - day [long] doing nothing - he asked . . .

verses.original: Ὅτι οὐδεὶς ἐμισθώσατο ἡμᾶς Λέγουσιν αὐτῷ Λέγει αὐτοῖς ὑμεῖς καὶ Ὑπάγετε εἰς τὸν ἀμπελῶνα
verses.transliteration: Hoti oudeis emisthōsato hēmas Legousin autō Legei autois hymeis kai Hypagete eis ton ampelōna
verses.literal: Because no one has hired us they answered . . . So he told them You also go into [my] vineyard

verses.original: δὲ Ὀψίας γενομένης ὁ κύριος τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος λέγει τῷ αὐτοῦ ἐπιτρόπῳ Κάλεσον τοὺς ἐργάτας καὶ ἀπόδος αὐτοῖς τὸν μισθόν ἀρξάμενος ἀπὸ τῶν ἐσχάτων ἕως τῶν πρώτων
verses.transliteration: de Opsias genomenēs ho kyrios tou ampelōnos legei tō autou epitropō Kaleson tous ergatas kai apodos autois ton misthon arxamenos apo tōn eschatōn heōs tōn prōtōn
verses.literal: When evening came the owner of the vineyard said to his foreman Call the workers and pay them [their] wages starting with the last [ones hired] and moving on to the first

verses.original: Καὶ οἱ περὶ τὴν ἑνδεκάτην ὥραν ἐλθόντες ἀνὰ ἔλαβον δηνάριον
verses.transliteration: Kai hoi peri tēn hendekatēn hōran elthontes ana elabon dēnarion
verses.literal: - [The workers who were hired] about the eleventh hour came [and] each received a denarius

verses.original: καὶ οἱ πρῶτοι ἐλθόντες ἐνόμισαν ὅτι λήμψονται πλεῖον καὶ ἀνὰ αὐτοί καὶ ἔλαβον τὸ δηνάριον
verses.transliteration: kai hoi prōtoi elthontes enomisan hoti lēmpsontai pleion kai ana autoi kai elabon to dēnarion
verses.literal: So when the original [workers] came they assumed - they would receive more But each of them also received - a denarius

verses.original: δὲ Λαβόντες ἐγόγγυζον κατὰ τοῦ οἰκοδεσπότου
verses.transliteration: de Labontes egongyzon kata tou oikodespotou
verses.literal: - On receiving [their pay] they began to grumble against the landowner

verses.original: Οὗτοι οἱ ἔσχατοι ἐποίησαν μίαν ὥραν λέγοντες καὶ ἐποίησας αὐτοὺς ἴσους ἡμῖν τοῖς βαστάσασι τὸ βάρος καὶ τὸν καύσωνα τῆς ἡμέρας
verses.transliteration: Houtoi hoi eschatoi epoiēsan mian hōran legontes kai epoiēsas autous isous hēmin tois bastasasi to baros kai ton kausōna tēs hēmeras
verses.literal: These [men who were hired] last worked only one hour they said and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden and the scorching heat of the day

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ ἀποκριθεὶς ἑνὶ αὐτῶν εἶπεν Ἑταῖρε οὐκ ἀδικῶ σε οὐχὶ συνεφώνησάς μοι δηναρίου
verses.transliteration: de Ho apokritheis heni autōn eipen Hetaire ouk adikō se ouchi synephōnēsas moi dēnariou
verses.literal: But - he answered one of them - Friend vvv I am not being unfair to you vvv Did you not agree with me on one denarius

verses.original: ἆρον σὸν τὸ καὶ ὕπαγε δὲ θέλω δοῦναι τούτῳ τῷ ἐσχάτῳ ὡς καὶ σοί
verses.transliteration: aron son to kai hypage de thelō dounai toutō tō eschatō hōs kai soi
verses.literal: Take your [pay] and go - I want to give this - last [man] the same as [I gave] you

verses.original: ἢ οὐκ ἔξεστίν μοι ποιῆσαι ὃ θέλω ἐν τοῖς ἐμοῖς ἢ ἐστιν σου ὁ ὀφθαλμός πονηρός ὅτι ἐγὼ εἰμι ἀγαθός
verses.transliteration: ē ouk exestin moi poiēsai ho thelō en tois emois ē estin sou ho ophthalmos ponēros hoti egō eimi agathos
verses.literal: vvv vvv Do I not have the right . . . to do as I please with what [is] mine Or are you . . . . . . . . . envious because I am generous

verses.original: Οὕτως οἱ ἔσχατοι ἔσονται πρῶτοι καὶ οἱ πρῶτοι ἔσχατοι
verses.transliteration: Houtōs hoi eschatoi esontai prōtoi kai hoi prōtoi eschatoi
verses.literal: So the last will be first and the first [will be] last

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀναβαίνων ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα παρέλαβεν τοὺς δώδεκα μαθητὰς κατ’ ἰδίαν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: Kai ho Iēsous anabainōn en tē hodō eis Hierosolyma parelaben tous dōdeka mathētas kat’ idian kai eipen autois
verses.literal: As - Jesus was going up - - - to Jerusalem He took the twelve disciples aside - and said -

verses.original: Ἰδοὺ ἀναβαίνομεν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα καὶ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδοθήσεται τοῖς ἀρχιερεῦσιν καὶ γραμματεῦσιν καὶ κατακρινοῦσιν αὐτὸν εἰς θανάτῳ
verses.transliteration: Idou anabainomen eis Hierosolyma kai ho Huios tou anthrōpou paradothēsetai tois archiereusin kai grammateusin kai katakrinousin auton eis thanatō
verses.literal: Look we are going up to Jerusalem and the Son - of Man will be delivered over to the chief priests and scribes - They will condemn Him to death

verses.original: καὶ παραδώσουσιν αὐτὸν εἰς τοῖς ἔθνεσιν τὸ ἐμπαῖξαι καὶ μαστιγῶσαι καὶ σταυρῶσαι καὶ τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ ἐγερθήσεται
verses.transliteration: kai paradōsousin auton eis tois ethnesin to empaixai kai mastigōsai kai staurōsai kai tē tritē hēmera egerthēsetai
verses.literal: and will deliver Him {over} to the Gentiles - to be mocked and flogged and crucified And on the third day He will be raised [to life]

verses.original: Τότε ἡ μήτηρ Ζεβεδαίου τῶν υἱῶν προσῆλθεν αὐτῷ μετὰ αὐτῆς τῶν υἱῶν προσκυνοῦσα καὶ αἰτοῦσά τι ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Tote hē mētēr Zebedaiou tōn huiōn prosēlthen autō meta autēs tōn huiōn proskynousa kai aitousa ti ap’ autou
verses.literal: Then the mother of Zebedee’s - sons came to [Jesus] with her - sons [and] knelt down - to make a request . . . of Him

verses.original: Τί θέλεις δὲ Ὁ εἶπεν αὐτῇ Λέγει αὐτῷ Εἰπὲ ἵνα ἐν σου τῇ βασιλείᾳ εἷς οὗτοι δύο οἱ υἱοί μου καθίσωσιν ἐκ σου δεξιῶν καὶ εἷς ἐξ σου εὐωνύμων
verses.transliteration: Ti theleis de Ho eipen autē Legei autō Eipe hina en sou tē basileia heis houtoi dyo hoi huioi mou kathisōsin ek sou dexiōn kai heis ex sou euōnymōn
verses.literal: What do you want - - He inquired - She answered . . . Declare that in Your - kingdom one of these two - sons of mine may sit at Your right hand and [the other] at Your left

verses.original: Οὐκ οἴδατε τί αἰτεῖσθε δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν δύνασθε πιεῖν τὸ ποτήριον ὃ ἐγὼ μέλλω πίνειν Δυνάμεθα Λέγουσιν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Ouk oidate ti aiteisthe de ho Iēsous Apokritheis eipen dynasthe piein to potērion ho egō mellō pinein Dynametha Legousin autō
verses.literal: vvv You do not know what you are asking - - Jesus replied - Can you drink the cup - I am going to drink We can [the brothers] answered . . .

verses.original: μὲν πίεσθε μου Τὸ ποτήριόν Λέγει αὐτοῖς δὲ τὸ καθίσαι ἐκ μου δεξιῶν καὶ ἐξ εὐωνύμων τοῦτο ἔστιν οὐκ ἐμὸν δοῦναι ἀλλ’ οἷς ὑπὸ μου τοῦ Πατρός ἡτοίμασται
verses.transliteration: men piesthe mou To potērion Legei autois de to kathisai ek mou dexiōn kai ex euōnymōn touto estin ouk emon dounai all’ hois hypo mou tou Patros hētoimastai
verses.literal: vvv You will indeed drink My - cup [Jesus] said - But - to sit at My right [or] - left - is not Mine to grant [These seats belong] to those for whom - My - Father has prepared them

verses.original: Καὶ οἱ δέκα ἀκούσαντες ἠγανάκτησαν περὶ τῶν δύο ἀδελφῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai hoi deka akousantes ēganaktēsan peri tōn dyo adelphōn
verses.literal: When the ten heard about [this] they were indignant with the two brothers

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς προσκαλεσάμενος αὐτοὺς εἶπεν Οἴδατε ὅτι οἱ ἄρχοντες τῶν ἐθνῶν κατακυριεύουσιν αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ μεγάλοι κατεξουσιάζουσιν αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: de ho Iēsous proskalesamenos autous eipen Oidate hoti hoi archontes tōn ethnōn katakyrieuousin autōn kai hoi megaloi katexousiazousin autōn
verses.literal: But - Jesus called them aside . . . [and] said You know that the rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them and [their] superiors exercise authority over them

verses.original: οὐχ ἔσται οὕτως ἐν ὑμῖν ἀλλ’ ὃς ἐὰν θέλῃ γενέσθαι μέγας ἐν ὑμῖν ἔσται ὑμῶν διάκονος
verses.transliteration: ouch estai houtōs en hymin all’ hos ean thelē genesthai megas en hymin estai hymōn diakonos
verses.literal: vvv It shall not be this way among you Instead whoever . . . wants to become great among you must be your servant

verses.original: καὶ ὃς ἂν θέλῃ εἶναι πρῶτος ἐν ὑμῖν ἔσται ὑμῶν δοῦλος
verses.transliteration: kai hos an thelē einai prōtos en hymin estai hymōn doulos
verses.literal: and whoever . . . wants to be first among you must be your slave

verses.original: ὥσπερ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου οὐκ ἦλθεν διακονηθῆναι ἀλλὰ διακονῆσαι καὶ δοῦναι αὐτοῦ τὴν ψυχὴν λύτρον ἀντὶ πολλῶν
verses.transliteration: hōsper ho Huios tou anthrōpou ouk ēlthen diakonēthēnai alla diakonēsai kai dounai autou tēn psychēn lytron anti pollōn
verses.literal: just as the Son - of Man vvv did not come to be served but to serve and to give His - life [as] a ransom for many

verses.original: Καὶ αὐτῶν ἐκπορευομένων ἀπὸ Ἰεριχὼ πολύς ὄχλος ἠκολούθησεν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Kai autōn ekporeuomenōn apo Ierichō polys ochlos ēkolouthēsen autō
verses.literal: - [As] they were leaving . . . Jericho a large crowd followed Him

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ δύο τυφλοὶ καθήμενοι παρὰ τὴν ὁδόν ἀκούσαντες ὅτι Ἰησοῦς παράγει ἔκραξαν λέγοντες Κύριε υἱὸς Δαυίδ ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς
verses.transliteration: kai idou dyo typhloi kathēmenoi para tēn hodon akousantes hoti Iēsous paragei ekraxan legontes Kyrie huios Dauid eleēson hēmas
verses.literal: And there were two blind [men] sitting beside the road When they heard that Jesus was passing by they cried out . . . Lord Son of David have mercy on us

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ ὄχλος ἐπετίμησεν αὐτοῖς ἵνα σιωπήσωσιν δὲ οἱ ἔκραξαν μεῖζον λέγοντες Κύριε υἱὸς Δαυίδ ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς
verses.transliteration: de Ho ochlos epetimēsen autois hina siōpēsōsin de hoi ekraxan meizon legontes Kyrie huios Dauid eleēson hēmas
verses.literal: - The crowd admonished them - to be silent but - they cried out all the louder - Lord Son of David have mercy on us

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς στὰς ἐφώνησεν αὐτοὺς Τί θέλετε ποιήσω ὑμῖν καὶ εἶπεν
verses.transliteration: Kai ho Iēsous stas ephōnēsen autous Ti thelete poiēsō hymin kai eipen
verses.literal: - - Jesus stopped [and] called them What do you want Me to do for you - He asked

verses.original: Κύριε Λέγουσιν αὐτῷ ἵνα ἡμῶν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ἀνοιγῶσιν
verses.transliteration: Kyrie Legousin autō hina hēmōn hoi ophthalmoi anoigōsin
verses.literal: Lord they answered . . . let our - eyes be opened

verses.original: δὲ Σπλαγχνισθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἥψατο αὐτῶν τῶν ὀμμάτων καὶ εὐθέως ἀνέβλεψαν καὶ ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: de Splanchnistheis ho Iēsous hēpsato autōn tōn ommatōn kai eutheōs aneblepsan kai ēkolouthēsan autō
verses.literal: - Moved with compassion - Jesus touched their - eyes and at once they received their sight and followed Him
